scope: Sanitized source capability findings and official documentation references captured during planning; re-probe before implementation and release.

official_documentation_findings.claim: Label-definition webhooks differ from applying labels to issues; Metadata read is documented for subscribing. Milestone-definition webhooks differ from attaching issues to milestones; Issues OR Pull requests read is documented for subscribing. Verify each supported action and hydration endpoint in the App canary.

ProjectV2 exposes field, view and workflow connections. View/workflow configuration snapshots and updatedAt do not provide an edit actor history; evidence-reviewed configuration recognition remains necessary unless a specific event source is proven.
TransferredEvent and PinnedEvent expose actor and createdAt in the live schema. Reorder history is a separate capability and must not be inferred from subissue add/remove events or current order.

pull_request_review_thread is a documented webhook with Pull requests read permission; resolved payload includes optional sender and updated_at. Verify non-null timestamp semantics in a canary; missing sender/time cannot create named time-window credit.
Public Events API has 300-event/30-day bounded history and can lag by 30 seconds to 6 hours. It is not the source of truth for a live historical leaderboard.
PR files endpoint returns a maximum of 3000 files; large/truncated diffs need a safe Git fallback or visible partial coverage.
Failed webhooks are not automatically redelivered; recent delivery visibility/redelivery spans 3 days; App webhook delivery endpoints require App JWT.
Project item changes and status updates have organization webhook events and Projects organization read permission. Exact App subscription delivery needs canary verification.
UserContentEdit includes edit actor, timestamp, diff summary and deletion metadata. Current snapshot/latest-editor fields are not substitutes for complete history.
Issue subissue/dependency events are documented with Issues read permission. New relates-to cross-repository deliveries can omit counterpart data.
REST and GraphQL have separate primary budgets plus secondary limits; GraphQL pagination is 1-100 and total request node counts are limited. Treat HTTP 200 GraphQL errors as errors.
Repository statistics exclude merges and differ from event accounting; large repositories can have unavailable or zero addition/deletion statistics.

important_interpretations: Sample issue #40 is intentionally not a full timeline backfill: hasNextPage proves nested pagination is needed.
Some bot/system actors can have wasAutomated=false; actor identity and automation registry must be considered together.
UserContentEdits can contain initial creation data; no edit-count metric should count that as an additional edit.
No claim that a user-account actor performed a manual human action or that AI use can be detected.
